summary: Choose one proportional exaggeration that gives the subject character while preserving its identifying parts.
objective: At thumbnail size the defining silhouette is legible; in a close view functional parts still connect.
example_prompts: Make a stylized hill village with oversized roofs and readable building entrances.

principles: Choose one proportional exaggeration that gives the subject character while preserving its identifying parts.
implementation: Enlarge a roof, head or primary joint; repeat a smaller echo of that shape in secondary details rather than distorting every dimension.
Group surfaces into a few distinct finishes and use a broad key light to separate the primary masses.
Begin with a three-quarter view; give motion a clear anticipation and settling pose appropriate to the fictional action.
Push exactly one dimension to 1.6-2.0x its reference proportion and echo that shape at 0.3-0.4x in two secondary details; hold every other dimension within +/-10% so the part stays identifiable.
Read the silhouette as a 128 px thumbnail: the exaggerated mass should occupy 35-45% of the subject's bounding height and hold at least 3:1 luminance contrast against the backdrop.
observable_checks: At thumbnail size the defining silhouette is legible; in a close view functional parts still connect.

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for ACESFilmic tone mapping at renderer.toneMappingExposure 1.0; re-tune intensities and fog density under a different tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with hand-painted surfaces or low-poly geometry; stylization describes authored emphasis, not a mandatory mesh budget.

defaults.rationale: Stylisation is carried by one dominant mass, so the rig is built to make that mass the brightest and the only element above 0.8 luminance: a 45 degree key throws its silhouette back onto the ground as a second reading of the same shape. The 4:1 key:fill ratio keeps the secondary echoes legible instead of crushing them, and three separated roughness steps stop the exaggerated parts from merging into one plastic finish.

values.value_structure: 30/50/20 dark/mid/light; the exaggerated mass owns the only values above 0.8
values.saturation_rule: supporting masses <= 50% HSL saturation; the exaggerated feature may reach 80%

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 4:1 measured on a neutral card at the hero mass

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: three distinct roughness steps only - 0.45 painted metal, 0.65 wood, 0.8 cloth - so exaggerated masses never share one finish

values.signature_technique: a single 1.8x hero exaggeration lit by a 45 degree key so its cast shadow repeats the exaggerated shape on the ground plane
never: one roughness value across all parts
